thesis_triggers.event: $1.40 x ~231M = ~$323M, below the ~$355M projected Oct-2027 net cash with no value for operations or the ~$45-55M of haircut stakes. Getting there needs cash destroyed (Quantisimo/SAIQ-type transfers at losses, stake write-downs, related-party advances), a dilutive raise, or an abandoned PQC roadmap. agent_1's $1.50 is a reasonable early warning because it sits at bare forward cash per share.

supervisor_summary: Round 2 converged ($1.98-2.20, mean $2.09) because all five adopted the same verified cash roll-forward, share count and certification dates. That is one analysis, not independent agreement, but I re-checked it in the primary filings and it holds. LAES is a shrinking cash box: ~$464M now, ~$355M (~$1.53/share) by Oct-2027, inside a WISeKey-controlled group moving cash and assets into SAIQ and Quantisimo. PQC revenue is an H2-2027 story at best, after the end-2026 revenue line was quietly dropped. Fair value is ~$2.10 against the $2.375 close, with a cash-supported left tail and a warrant-capped hype right tail. I keep the forecaster mean ladder (low confidence); the only real open question is the operating multiple.
key_drivers: Cash backing: $486.1M at 30-Jun-2026, ~$464M now, ~$355M (~$1.53/share) by Oct-2027 on ~$50M burn and ~$55M of SEALQuantum deployments, against a ~$549M market cap at $2.375.
The operating multiple is the main open variable: the market pays ~$40-90M EV for a $27-36M-revenue business losing ~$60M a year; each 1x on ~$42M of 2027 revenue is ~$0.18/share.

PQC timing: the V1/V2 CC lab reports (Oct-26/Jan-27) are not certifications, EAL5+ certification is only targeted for '2027', the end-2026 QVault revenue line was dropped, and TPM-183/185 TCG are targeted for Feb/May-2027.
Governance: WISeKey (now WISeQey) control, $16.67M of related-party receivables ('management fees and advances'), the SAIQ PIPE and the Quantisimo asset contribution.
Quantum-sentiment right tail capped by 60.8M Class E warrants at $5.50 and the $28.9M ATM.
